meta.title: Bids well before the last minute do not move the end time
gaps: The vocabulary supports only two QA vendors, so the third vendor bid cannot be created.

There is no supported way to capture the initial ending_at value and compare it with the ending_at value after the bids; the plan only verifies that the end time is returned and that at least two bids exist.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live pricing round.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
A second QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
The buyer reads the pricing round.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that “ending at” is a Unix timestamp in seconds; “bid count” is at least 2.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “ending at” is a Unix timestamp in seconds; “bid count” is at least 2.
